notes: dc.html p14 section-card shell is identical to p15's (see settings-notifications.json note 1): ruling 5.1 gradient rule `height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5A5552,#5A5552 22%,rgba(90,85,82,.18))`, then a header row `padding:14px 16px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)` with an Anton 20px title and a 10.5px/600/#7A6E6C meta line.
The real `AccountCard` shell has no gradient-rule element (see settings-notifications.json note 4) — same finding, reused here rather than restated as a new discovery.

dc.html p14 table header row: `grid-template-columns:1fr 120px 150px 44px;height:30px;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7A6E6C;font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)`.
dc.html p14 member row: same grid, `min-height:48px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);font-size:12.5px`.

notes: dc.html p16: identity panel is `padding:48px 56px`, top rule `height:3px;width:160px;background:#5A5552;border-radius:2px;margin-bottom:22px`, wordmark `font-family:'Anton';font-size:30px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1`, tagline `font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7A6E6C;font-weight:600;margin-top:6px`.

This top rule is neither the masthead 3px cap (ruling 5.2, scoped to the 252px nav card) nor a section-card header (ruling 5.1) — it is the auth/onboarding identity mark, solid #5A5552 at a fixed 160px width, unrelated to either ruling. Recorded here as its own value rather than folded into either.

AuthTabs: dc.html p16 tab strip is `display:flex;gap:2px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12)`; active tab `padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;border-bottom:2px solid #5A5552;margin-bottom:-1px`; inactive tab `font-weight:600;color:#5A6B67`.

specs.source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' id="p15" (char 594212), the 'Notifications' section card; operator ruling 5.1 (2026-09-07)
notes: dc.html p15 section-card shell (used by every section card on this page, including Notifications): `background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(26,26,26,.04),0 4px 14px rgba(26,26,26,.06);overflow:hidden`, topped by the ruling 5.1 gradient rule `height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5A5552,#5A5552 22%,rgba(90,85,82,.18))`. Artboard and ruling agree here exactly, nothing to reconcile.

dc.html p15 header row: `padding:14px 16px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)`, title 'Notifications' `font-family:'Anton';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:20px`, meta 'In-app now · email and push coming' `font-size:10.5px;color:#7A6E6C;font-weight:600` (two font-weight declarations on the same rule in the source; the later one, 600, is what a browser applies and what this spec measures against).

dc.html p15 toggle row: `min-height:48px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06)`, label bold, sublabel `font-size:11px;color:#7A6E6C`; pill `width:32px;height:18px;border-radius:999px`, knob `width:14px;height:14px` inset 2px.

The real built shell, `src/components/account/AccountPrimitives.tsx`'s `AccountCard`, has NO gradient-rule element at all (its section renders straight into a header div, no 3px bar first-child) — the 'gradient rule' child target below is deliberately a broad `section > div` narrowed by `matchStyle` (README's own recommended technique for 'an element the product gives no marker attribute to'), so a genuinely absent rule reports NOT BUILT rather than a false MISMATCH against the header div sitting in that position.

The real `AccountCard` wrapper is the shared shell for this section AND the Account 'Members & roles' section (see account-members.json) — one spec file per section per this lane's PARTS list ('account/settings ... including ... the Notifications section'), same underlying component.

specs.source: src/components/pages/SettingsPage.tsx SETTINGS_SECTIONS constant (six entries: General, Notifications, Saved searches, Data & supersessions, Archive, Help); src/components/detail/DetailShell.tsx SectionIndex; README.md screen 15 note 'sticky S1 . S2 . S3 SectionIndex ... reusing ... the detail architecture'
notes: The design package's numbered artboards (p13-p17) do not draw Settings' own sticky S1..S6 row explicitly — SettingsPage.tsx's own header comment states the design intent directly ('items become anchored SECTIONS in one scrolling page, reusing the sticky S1 . S2 . S3 SectionIndex from the detail architecture'), so this spec measures the real shared SectionIndex component against ITS OWN stated geometry (src/components/detail/DetailShell.tsx), not a page-artboard pixel reading — there is no p15 SectionIndex block to grep. Flagged rather than silently substituted, per the harness's own instruction to record the divergence.

SectionIndex itself: `position:sticky;top:0;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between`. Each link: `S{n} · {label}`, `font-size:var(--fs-105)` (10.5px), `font-weight:700`, `min-height:44px` (the law-2 hit-target floor), separated by a middot `·` in var(--ink-3).

This is the settings-specific instance named by this lane's PARTS list ('the SectionIndex on settings') of an otherwise generic part — the same component also serves detail surfaces, out of this lane's scope.
